overall: The AG found the commission violated the 48-hour notice rule for its September 8 meeting, but accepted its September 28 re-meeting with repeated votes as cure and ordered no further relief; the property-specificity allegation was rejected.

allegations.summary: Alleged the commission posted notice for its September 8 meeting fewer than 48 hours in advance.
allegations.key_passage: The Commission therefore failed to post notice of the meeting at least 48 hours in advance, excluding the Monday holiday.

allegations.summary: Alleged the notice for an executive session on real estate acquisition did not identify the specific property involved.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Commission was entitled to withhold the identity of the property at issue, and we find that the Open Meeting Law was not violated in this regard.
